description.en:
Tracks buyer demand per selling station and fill type, and reduces the effective sale price as demand is consumed within a monthly period. Prices recover when a new period begins.
Version 0.1: - Single-player. - Monthly demand periods. - Demand tracked by sell station and fill type. - Continuous price multiplier (no hard sale caps). - XML save/load per savegame. - Console/log diagnostics prefixed with [RealisticMarketDemand].
